annotations.title: OCR: scanned PDF or image (Korean and English) to Markdown

description: Use when an agent must read text from a scan, photo or screenshot: scanned PDFs up to 5 MB (embedded JPEG page images) or PNG/JPEG/WebP images up to 4 MB, Korean and English, tables kept as Markdown. Up to 3 pages per call. Input: url via GET, or POST a file (multipart 'file', raw body, or JSON contentBase64). Output: JSON markdown, pages with confidence, warnings. PDFs with selectable text: use /v1/convert/markdown. Use instead: ai_vision for describing an image; convert_to_markdown for digital PDFs or DOCX. Example: ?url=<Tesseract eurotext.png sample> Price: $0.015 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

contentBase64.description: File bytes as base64 (MCP argument or POST JSON; alternative to url; max 5 MB decoded)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP image (≤ 4 MB) or a scanned PDF (≤ 5 MB). For uploads use POST.
